propositions: rebar comment accepts flag-looking tokens (--body-file, --body) as the comment body instead of rejecting them, storing the flag name as a 6-11 byte string and silently discarding the intended content
the command exits with code 0 and produces no stderr when a flag token is stored as body, making the data loss undetectable until content is read downstream
positional-body commands (comment, create, edit, session-log) lack a guard against flag-like arguments, allowing the same footgun across multiple command shapes
a user can bypass the guard using -- to pass a body that legitimately begins with a dash
the implementation must reject flag-like body arguments loudly rather than coerce or truncate them, and must document the -- escape hatch
